biotools.summary: Laserfarm is a FOSS wrapper to Laserchicken designed for macro-ecological research using massive LiDAR point cloud datasets. It provides pipelines for data preparation, processing, and analysis, enabling standardized vegetation structure metric extraction and facilitating site-specific ecological monitoring.
